title: Read-only Git log/show/branch arms still accept signature-verifier routes
outcome: Read-only reviewer Git classification refuses signature verification on log, show and branch the same way it now does on rev-list and for-each-ref.
acceptance: `git log --show-signature`, `git log`/`git show` with a `--pretty`/`--format` value that uses a %G placeholder (including magic-prefix forms) or a configured pretty alias that resolves to one, and `git branch --format=`/`--sort=` with signature atoms or sort keys are refused by the read-only classifier, shown by behavioural classifier tests
Ordinary read-only log, show and branch forms stay admitted
